stages.label: Under plastic
stages.note: Brown, green, violet, yellow and pink forms gathered in the upper half, painted over and around the plastic wrapper pinned to the canvas, with brown triangles below.

stages.label: A funnel
stages.note: The forms are carried down into a funnel that narrows to a point near the bottom: green and brown bands along its sides, with crimson, orange and mint green blocks inside.

stages.label: Grey washes
stages.note: The wrapper is gone. Pale grey washes spread around the funnel, with grey line work at the left, green circles and dark rings at the lower right, and violet squares at the lower left.

stages.label: Black lines and red
stages.note: Two days later black lines and red marks are drawn out to the edges: a red chalk star at the top right, red shapes at the left and right, and a dark band along the bottom.

stages.label: Violet
stages.note: The next day a violet and white shape is painted into the top right, with pale pink and grey washes over the background.

stages.label: Blue and orange
stages.note: Twelve days later blue and orange fill the angular shape at the top left, and more red and violet are added at the right edge.

emerging-valley.text: A stretched canvas worked from late September to November 2026, partly under its plastic wrapper. It began as a funnel of brown, green, violet and yellow forms in the upper half; through October the funnel was carried down to a point at the bottom, the wrapper came off and grey washes, black lines and red, violet and pink marks spread out across the whole canvas.
emerging-valley.title: Emerging Valley

stages.label: Primed sheet
stages.note: The sheet primed white and hung on a louvred door.

stages.label: First forms
stages.note: A cluster of red, green, violet, blue and pink forms in the middle of the sheet, with a looping dark green line, pale blue outlines at the left and ochre and yellow brushwork below.

stages.label: Spreading out
stages.note: The forms spread outwards: yellow and olive at the top, green and red at the left, a violet shape at the lower right, and a grey-black wash down the right side.

stages.label: Dark blue band
stages.note: A dark blue band is painted across the top and down both sides, framing the forms.

stages.label: Violet
stages.note: The blue band is painted over in violet, with darker blue dots at the top left; grey shapes and a chain of blue dots are added at the lower left.

second-creation.text: Painted in one day, 10 November 2026, on a sheet primed white that morning. A cluster of coloured forms came first; through the afternoon it spread outwards, a grey-black wash ran down the right side, and a dark blue band was painted across the top. In the evening the band was painted over in violet.
second-creation.title: Second Creation

untitled-2017-05-29.text: Sharp strokes of blue, red, yellow and brown packed across a long sheet.
untitled-2017-05-29.title: Untitled (Coloured shards)

untitled-2017-05-29-2.text: Blue, orange and turquoise shapes with black line work across a long horizontal sheet.
untitled-2017-05-29-2.title: Untitled (Blue and orange)

untitled-2017-05-29-3.text: Yellow, blue and violet arcs and angular shapes on a large white sheet.
untitled-2017-05-29-3.title: Untitled (Yellow and blue arcs)

untitled-2023-11-07.text: Black and dark blue loops drawn over bright blue.
untitled-2023-11-07.title: Untitled (Black loops on blue)

stages.label: Scattered marks

stages.label: Arcs
stages.note: An hour later more blue and pink marks and yellow arcs are added.

stages.label: Green and orange
stages.note: Three days later green, orange, yellow and red are added, mostly in the upper half.

untitled-2023-11-23.text: Short marks of blue, magenta and green scattered over white paper. Within an hour more blue, pink and yellow arcs were added, and three days later green, orange and red. (The second photo is turned to match the others.)
untitled-2023-11-23.title: Untitled (Scattered marks)

untitled-2023-11-27.text: Black, green and dark red strokes crossing a yellow ground.
untitled-2023-11-27.title: Untitled (Black and green on yellow)

stages.label: Blue strokes
stages.note: Blue brushstrokes scattered across the sheet.

stages.label: Green and yellow
stages.note: Two days later green and yellow washes spread across the lower half, with a small brown structure near the middle.

untitled-2023-11-29.text: Blue brushstrokes scattered across white paper. Two days later green and yellow washes were added across the lower half, with a small brown structure near the middle.
untitled-2023-11-29.title: Untitled (Blue strokes and green)

untitled-2023-12-03.text: A tangle of black, brown and blue lines over light blue.
untitled-2023-12-03.title: Untitled (Blue and black tangle)

untitled-2023-12-07.text: Blue, green, red and black loops over a turquoise ground.
untitled-2023-12-07.title: Untitled (Blue and green loops)

stages.label: On white
stages.note: Blue swirls with pink and red shapes and a yellow band, on a white canvas.

stages.label: Background
stages.note: Six days later the background is painted in yellow, red and deep blue, with orange shapes along the bottom.

untitled-2024-01-17.text: Blue swirls, pink and red shapes and a yellow band on a white canvas. Six days later the background was painted in: yellow at the top, red at the right and deep blue below.
untitled-2024-01-17.title: Untitled (Blue swirl on yellow and red)

stages.label: Close up
stages.note: Dark blue and black loops over red and pink.

stages.label: On the floor
stages.note: The whole round panel on the floor forty minutes later, with white loops across it.

untitled-2024-01-24.text: A round panel covered in dark blue and black loops over red and pink, with white line work across it.
untitled-2024-01-24.title: Untitled (Round, blue and red)

stages.label: Swirls
stages.note: Blue and turquoise swirls with yellow and green on white paper.

stages.label: Filled out
stages.note: An hour later the swirls are fuller, with more blue, turquoise and yellow.

untitled-2024-01-26.text: Blue, turquoise and yellow swirls on white paper, filled out within the hour. (The first photo is turned to match the second.)
untitled-2024-01-26.title: Untitled (Blue swirls)

stages.label: Loops
stages.note: Loops and lines in red, blue, yellow and black on white paper.

stages.label: Yellow and turquoise
stages.note: Three days later yellow and turquoise washes fill the background around the loops.

untitled-2024-01-29.text: Coloured loops and lines on white paper. Three days later yellow and turquoise washes filled the background around them.
untitled-2024-01-29.title: Untitled (Yellow and turquoise)

untitled-2024-02-07.text: A dense painting of blue, violet, green and white forms around a green spiral in the middle.
untitled-2024-02-07.title: Untitled (Green spiral)

stages.label: Red and pale blue
stages.note: Red and pale blue marks scraped and brushed across the sheet.

stages.label: Dark blue
stages.note: Three hours later dark blue, yellow and green strokes are added through the middle and lower right.

untitled-2024-02-19.text: Red and pale blue marks scraped across a white sheet. Three hours later dark blue, yellow and green strokes were added through the middle.
untitled-2024-02-19.title: Untitled (Red and blue scrapes)

stages.label: Violet loops
stages.note: Violet and pink loops with blue shapes at the top, on a large white sheet laid on a table.

stages.label: Filled
stages.note: Twelve days later yellow, red, blue and black fill the sheet over and around the loops.

untitled-2024-02-25.text: Violet and pink loops with a few blue shapes on a large white sheet. Twelve days later the sheet was filled with yellow, red, blue and black.
untitled-2024-02-25.title: Untitled (Loops and blue shapes)

stages.label: First photo
stages.note: Dark blue loops over yellow, red and turquoise.

stages.label: Straight on
stages.note: An hour later, photographed straight on.

untitled-2024-03-02.text: Heavy dark blue loops over yellow, red, orange and turquoise. (The first photo is turned to match the second.)
untitled-2024-03-02.title: Untitled (Deep blue loops)

stages.label: On the floor
stages.note: Loops and spirals in blue, red, orange and yellow across the whole sheet.

stages.label: The next day
stages.note: Hung above another work on paper.

untitled-2024-03-23.text: Loops and spirals in blue, red, orange and yellow across a white sheet, photographed on the floor and the next day hung above another work.
untitled-2024-03-23.title: Untitled (Blue and red loops)

stages.label: Spirals
stages.note: Spirals and loops in blue, red, green and yellow across the whole sheet.

stages.label: Yellow centre
stages.note: The yellow and orange at the centre are strengthened.

untitled-2024-03-29.text: Spirals and loops in blue, red, green and yellow spread across the sheet; within half an hour the yellow and orange in the middle were strengthened. (The first photo is turned to match the second.)
untitled-2024-03-29.title: Untitled (Coloured spirals)

untitled-2024-04-22.text: A blue circle at the bottom of a field of red, yellow, orange and blue marks, with arcs and loops above.
untitled-2024-04-22.title: Untitled (Blue circle in colour)

stages.label: Structures
stages.note: Blue, red, ochre and black structures packed across the sheet.

stages.label: Violet
stages.note: The next day violet washes are added over the right side and the lower half.

untitled-2024-04-26.text: Blue, red, ochre and black structures packed across a sheet. The next day violet washes were added over the right side and the lower half.
untitled-2024-04-26.title: Untitled (Violet and blue structures)

stages.label: Finished on paper
stages.note: Blue, red, yellow and orange lines stacked into a dense horizontal grid.

stages.label: Framed
stages.note: Five days later, in a black frame.

stages.label: A year later
stages.note: Framed, leaning against the wall beside another painting.

untitled-2024-04-27.text: Dense lines in blue, red, yellow and orange built into a horizontal grid on white paper. Five days later it was in a black frame. (The framed photo from May is turned to match.)
untitled-2024-04-27.title: Untitled (Coloured scaffolding)

untitled-2024-04-29.text: A small watercolour of four figures in blue line over magenta and blue washes.
untitled-2024-04-29.title: Untitled (Four figures)

untitled-2024-05-02.text: Pink, turquoise, yellow and black blocks crowded together, in a black frame.
untitled-2024-05-02.title: Untitled (Pink and turquoise)

stages.label: Loose lines
stages.note: Loose lines in orange, teal, yellow and violet across a large white sheet.

stages.label: Packed
stages.note: Four days later the lines are packed much more densely, in blue, red, yellow and black.

stages.label: Dark top
stages.note: That evening black and grey brushwork darkens the top edge, with blue shapes in the corners.

stages.label: Framed
stages.note: In a black frame, more than a year later.

untitled-2024-05-09.text: A large sheet that began as loose coloured lines. Four days later the lines were packed far more densely, and that evening black and grey brushwork darkened the top edge. It was framed in black the following year. (The second photo is turned to match.)
untitled-2024-05-09.title: Untitled (Dense colour, dark top)

stages.label: Angles
stages.note: Angular yellow, red, blue and black forms across the sheet.

stages.label: Sharpened
stages.note: Three days later the forms are sharper, with more red, pink and light blue.

untitled-2024-05-14.text: Angular yellow, red, blue and black forms on white paper. Three days later the forms were sharpened with more red, pink and light blue. (The first photo is turned to match the second.)
untitled-2024-05-14.title: Untitled (Yellow and blue angles)

untitled-2024-05-29.text: Tower-like structures in blue, violet and white rise from the bottom of the sheet under a dark grey top.
untitled-2024-05-29.title: Untitled (Blue towers)

untitled-2024-06-14.text: Two circular, fisheye-style versions made from photos of Untitled (Blue and orange).
untitled-2024-06-14.title: Untitled (Blue and orange, circular versions)

untitled-2024-06-25.text: A long sheet of yellow, ochre, grey and blue bars with heavy black strokes, photographed laid out flat.
untitled-2024-06-25.title: Untitled (Yellow and black, long sheet)

stages.label: Hanging
stages.note: Orange, yellow, blue and teal marks down the length of a hanging white sheet.

stages.label: Lit at night
stages.note: Four days later, hung in a darkened room under a single light.

untitled-2024-07-08.text: A tall hanging sheet with orange, yellow, blue and teal marks running from top to bottom.
untitled-2024-07-08.title: Untitled (Long hanging sheet)

stages.label: Grey and green
stages.note: Grey, white, dark green and blue shapes in the upper part of the sheet, with black strokes below.

stages.label: Turquoise
stages.note: A month later bright turquoise is added at the top left and around the shapes.

untitled-2025-06-09.text: Grey, white, dark green and blue shapes gathered in the upper part of a tall kraft sheet. A month later bright turquoise was added around them.
untitled-2025-06-09.title: Untitled (Turquoise on kraft)

stages.label: June
stages.note: A large kraft sheet on the wall, with grey, white and dark brushwork spreading out from the middle.

stages.label: End of June
stages.note: The kraft sheet among other sheets, with green, red and dark lines at its left.

stages.label: July
stages.note: A white sheet beside it, covered in grey and black brushwork with white lines.

stages.label: Late July
stages.note: White sheets with blue, orange and black line drawings hung around the kraft sheet.

stages.label: October
stages.note: The kraft sheet now carries black, white and grey lines, next to a white sheet with green and blue lines and a bright green patch.

stages.label: Beside Yellow hook
stages.note: An hour later the kraft sheet hangs beside the white sheet of Untitled (Yellow hook) with its black dotted lines.

untitled-2025-06-09-3.text: Photographs of one studio wall from June to October 2025, as sheets were hung, worked on and replaced. A large kraft sheet in the middle of the wall changes throughout; in October it hangs beside the white sheet of Untitled (Yellow hook).
untitled-2025-06-09-3.title: Untitled (Studio wall)

stages.label: Loops
stages.note: Brown and ochre loops with violet and orange shapes on a hanging white sheet.

stages.label: Black lines
stages.note: A week later black lines are drawn through the middle and the orange is stronger.

untitled-2025-06-30.text: Brown and ochre loops with violet and orange on a hanging white sheet. A week later black lines were drawn through the middle.
untitled-2025-06-30.title: Untitled (Violet and orange loops)

untitled-2025-07-01.text: Blue grid lines and long blue drips frame pink, green and yellow forms in the middle of a kraft sheet.
untitled-2025-07-01.title: Untitled (Blue grid on kraft)

stages.label: Coloured loops
stages.note: Pink, green, dark blue and black loops climb a tall kraft sheet, with a pale yellow arc.

stages.label: White loops
stages.note: Two months later white looping lines are added over the lower half.

untitled-2025-07-07.text: Pink, green, dark blue and black loops climbing a tall kraft sheet. Two months later white looping lines were added over the lower half.
untitled-2025-07-07.title: Untitled (White loops on kraft)

untitled-2025-07-13.text: Two sheets hung one above the other, with black looping lines and patches of yellow.
untitled-2025-07-13.title: Untitled (Black and yellow, two sheets)

stages.label: Blue and red
stages.note: Blue, violet and red lines across a row of white sheets.

stages.label: Orange and black
stages.note: Orange, ochre and black lines are added over the right-hand sheets.

untitled-2025-07-19.text: Lines in blue, violet and red across a row of white sheets. Later that afternoon orange, ochre and black lines were added on the right-hand sheets.
untitled-2025-07-19.title: Untitled (Blue, red and orange lines)

stages.label: Pale blue
stages.note: Black branching lines and a pale blue shape, with a touch of green.

stages.label: Blue and green
stages.note: Blue fills the shape, green and yellow are added at the right, and small red marks appear below.

untitled-2025-07-22.text: Black branching lines around a pale blue shape on white paper. An hour later the shape was filled with stronger blue and green was added at the right.
untitled-2025-07-22.title: Untitled (Blue and black branches)

stages.label: Black ink
stages.note: Dense black marks at the right, lighter ones in the middle, and one long line looping round the left.

stages.label: Teal washes
stages.note: Three days later teal and pale blue washes spread across the top and middle.

stages.label: Orange-pink
stages.note: An hour later orange-pink appears at the top left, with more teal and touches of rust.

stages.label: Pale yellow
stages.note: Six days later the area inside the long loop is filled with pale yellow.

stages.label: Blue outside
stages.note: Two hours later blue wash covers the outside of the loop, out to the edges.

untitled-2025-08-16.text: A long sheet that began as a black ink drawing, with one line looping round its left half. Over nine days teal, orange-pink, pale yellow and finally blue washes were added, the yellow filling the loop and the blue covering everything outside it.
untitled-2025-08-16.title: Untitled (Teal and black on a long sheet)

stages.label: Teal
stages.note: Teal lines and loops across a cream sheet.

stages.label: Black
stages.note: Black marks and short black lines are laid over the teal, mostly in the middle.

untitled-2025-08-27.text: Teal lines brushed across a cream sheet; just over an hour later black marks were laid over them.
untitled-2025-08-27.title: Untitled (Teal and black)

stages.label: Black lines
stages.note: Black looping lines down a tall kraft panel, with touches of yellow.

stages.label: Green and ochre
stages.note: Green and ochre are added among the black lines at the top.

untitled-2025-09-05.text: Black looping lines running down a tall kraft panel. Within the hour green and ochre were added among the lines at the top.
untitled-2025-09-05.title: Untitled (Tall kraft panel)

untitled-2025-09-19.text: Grey, white, ochre and silver brushwork moving across the whole sheet.
untitled-2025-09-19.title: Untitled (Grey and silver)

untitled-2025-09-21.text: Coloured line work under a yellow arc of loops and hatching, framed behind glass.
untitled-2025-09-21.title: Untitled (Yellow arc)

untitled-2025-09-21-3.text: A digital colour version made from part of Untitled (Yellow arc).
untitled-2025-09-21-3.title: Untitled (Yellow arc, digital)

untitled-2025-09-26.text: White dry-brushed blocks, bars and curves built up over dark grey paper.
untitled-2025-09-26.title: Untitled (White on grey)

untitled-2025-09-29.text: Angular blocks of dark green, pale blue, ochre and white, edged in dark blue, across orange paper.
untitled-2025-09-29.title: Untitled (Blocks on orange)

untitled-2025-10-01.text: Dense black, maroon, grey and ochre marks over a pale yellow ground.
untitled-2025-10-01.title: Untitled (Maroon and ochre)

stages.label: Blue blocks
stages.note: A cluster of blue and white blocks with dark lines reaching out across the kraft paper.

stages.label: Pale blue and black
stages.note: Pale blue and black brushwork wraps around the blocks at the top and bottom.

stages.label: Pink outlines
stages.note: Pink outlines and pink shapes are drawn over the left side and through the blocks.

untitled-2025-10-06.text: Blue and white blocks, built up like a collage on kraft paper, with dark lines around them. Two weeks later pale blue and black brushwork wrapped around the blocks, and pink outlines were added a few days after that. (The first photo is turned to match the others.)
untitled-2025-10-06.title: Untitled (Blue blocks)

stages.label: Red and green lines
stages.note: Red patches and loose green lines on white paper, with an ochre outline at the left.

stages.label: Violet and pink
stages.note: Violet, pink and yellow fill the shapes in the middle, more red is added, and the green lines reach further across.

untitled-2025-10-25.text: Red and green lines on white paper with an ochre outline. By the afternoon violet, pink and yellow filled the shapes in the middle and the red had spread. (The first photo is turned to match the second.)
untitled-2025-10-25.title: Untitled (Red, green and violet)

stages.label: Green and pink
stages.note: Dark green and pink shapes over a black ground, with white showing along the edges.

stages.label: Grey edges
stages.note: Grey covers the white areas along the left and right edges.

untitled-2025-10-28.text: Dark green, pink and white shapes packed over black. An hour later grey was brushed over the white areas along the edges.
untitled-2025-10-28.title: Untitled (Green and pink on black)

untitled-2025-11-03.text: White lines and pale pink patches drawn over kraft paper, with dark brown marks in the middle and lower half.
untitled-2025-11-03.title: Untitled (White lines and brown)

stages.label: White lines
stages.note: White lines and dotted marks across three kraft panels, with blue and pale pink on the left.

stages.label: Black marks
stages.note: Black marks and short black lines are added to the middle and left panels.

untitled-2025-11-03-2.text: Three kraft panels drawn in white, with blue and pale pink on the left one. Within the hour black marks were added across the middle and left panels.
untitled-2025-11-03-2.title: Untitled (White lines on three panels)

stages.label: Three sheets
stages.note: Blue, red and black brushwork on the left and middle sheets; black grid lines and shapes on the right sheet.

stages.label: Green and red
stages.note: Green enters the left and middle sheets, more red is added at the top, and red marks appear inside the black grid on the right.

untitled-2025-11-05.text: Three white sheets hung together: blue, red and black brushwork on the left two and a black grid on the right. A week later green was added to the left and middle sheets and red came into the right one.
untitled-2025-11-05.title: Untitled (Three sheets, blue and black)

untitled-2025-11-09.text: Green leaf-like strokes and a yellow flower shape over brown lines, a pale blue wash and an orange band at the top, on kraft paper.
untitled-2025-11-09.title: Untitled (Green leaves)

stages.label: Ochre lines
stages.note: Looping ochre and brown lines across two white sheets.

stages.label: Green and dark red
stages.note: Green and dark red washes are brushed over the lower half of both sheets.

untitled-2025-11-11.text: Two sheets drawn with ochre and brown lines. Within the hour green and dark red washes were brushed over the lower parts of both.
untitled-2025-11-11.title: Untitled (Ochre lines, green wash)

untitled-2025-11-11-2.text: A dense drawing in black and dark blue line on kraft paper, with grey washes in the middle.
untitled-2025-11-11-2.title: Untitled (Black lines on kraft)

untitled-2025-11-13.text: Black blocks and blue grid lines on kraft paper above orange and brown brushstrokes that sweep down to the right.
untitled-2025-11-13.title: Untitled (Blue grid and orange)

untitled-2025-11-17.text: Vertical bands of yellow, grey, green and deep blue on kraft paper under a black and red shape at the top.
untitled-2025-11-17.title: Untitled (Blue and yellow columns)

stages.label: Outlines
stages.note: Looping black outlines and dotted lines across the three sheets, with an ochre band through the middle.

stages.label: Blue and teal
stages.note: Blue, teal and green fill the shapes on the left and middle sheets, and blue appears on the right sheet.

untitled-2025-11-30.text: A long work on three white sheets. It began as looping black outlines with dotted lines and a band of ochre across the middle; an hour later the shapes at the left and centre were filled with blue, teal and green.
untitled-2025-11-30.title: Untitled (Blue and ochre band)

untitled-2025-11-30-2.text: Blocks of yellow, orange, blue and violet on kraft paper, with a brown band running down the middle.
untitled-2025-11-30-2.title: Untitled (Yellow and blue on kraft)

stages.label: Pointed forms
stages.note: Red, cream, yellow and black shapes with long pointed ends spread across the three panels.

stages.label: Filled out
stages.note: Pink, cream and white fill out the shapes and join them from one panel to the next.

stages.label: On the floor
stages.note: Later that afternoon the three panels laid out on the floor.

untitled-2025-12-01.text: Three kraft-paper panels painted in one afternoon, hung side by side. Red, pink, cream, yellow and black forms with long pointed shapes went down first; half an hour later they were filled out and joined across the panels, and by evening the panels were laid out on the floor. (The last photo is turned to match the first two.)
untitled-2025-12-01.title: Untitled (Pink and red triptych)

stages.label: Black lines and a kraft sheet
stages.note: Black line drawing on the white sheets with touches of grey and green; the kraft sheet in the middle has pink, ochre and blue forms.

stages.label: Teal
stages.note: Teal is brushed into the left and middle sheets, and the kraft sheet gains black and red; the sheets now hang close together.

untitled-2025-12-01-2.text: Three sheets hung side by side: two of white paper drawn in black, with a kraft sheet between them carrying colour. Two days later teal was brushed into the left and middle sheets and more black and red went into the kraft sheet.
untitled-2025-12-01-2.title: Untitled (Teal on three sheets)

stages.label: Blue and orange
stages.note: Blue and orange-brown brush lines over the whole sheet, with two black rectangles in the middle.

stages.label: Black
stages.note: Heavy black brush shapes build a dense structure over the blue and orange.

untitled-black-over-blue-2025.text: Blue and orange-brown brush lines across a cream sheet, with two black blocks in the middle. Two weeks later heavy black shapes were built over most of the surface.
untitled-black-over-blue-2025.title: Untitled (Black over blue)

untitled-blue-and-gold-2025.text: A long horizontal painting of blue, gold and white forms moving across a smoky grey ground, shown here in its gold frame.
untitled-blue-and-gold-2025.title: Untitled (Blue and gold)

stages.label: Branching lines
stages.note: Black branching lines over a pale blue-grey wash, with grey and blue planes filling cells in the upper half.

stages.label: Sky blue
stages.note: The ground turns a stronger blue, and heavy black angular lines fill the lower half.

untitled-blue-lines-2025.text: Black branching lines over a pale blue-grey wash, with some of the cells between them filled in grey and blue. Two weeks later the ground was turned a stronger sky blue and heavy black lines built a dense structure in the lower half.
untitled-blue-lines-2025.title: Untitled (Blue lines)

stages.label: White forms
stages.note: Pale grey, blue and ochre washes, with white shapes outlined over them, yellow loops, teal and pink strokes and thin violet lines; a rose wash runs along the bottom.

stages.label: Filled with colour
stages.note: The next day the shapes are filled in: red, brown and black at the top, yellow loops in the middle, violet, rose and pale blue at the left, and green and rose at the lower right.

stages.label: Dark blue and violet
stages.note: That afternoon dark blue and violet shapes are added at the left and below the centre, and the green-yellow shape at the right becomes brighter yellow.

untitled-cluster-on-pale-washes-2026.text: A cluster of forms on a canvas washed in pale grey, blue and ochre. On 11 November it was a loose arrangement of white shapes with yellow, teal, pink and violet lines; by the next day the shapes were filled with red, brown, yellow, violet and green, and dark blue and violet were added that afternoon.
untitled-cluster-on-pale-washes-2026.title: Untitled (Cluster on pale washes)

stages.label: The figure
stages.note: Long black lines frame a form in grey, green and yellow; a red mark and a looping grey-brown shape sit at the upper right.

stages.label: Pink-violet
stages.note: Pink-violet paint is brushed across the middle of the figure.

stages.label: Teal and dark red
stages.note: Teal zigzags run along the top, and a band of dark red crosses the centre.

untitled-green-figure-2025.text: A figure-like form in grey, green and yellow, set inside long black lines on a large white sheet. Over two and a half weeks, pink-violet and then teal and dark red were added.
untitled-green-figure-2025.title: Untitled (Green figure)

stages.label: Lines across three panels
stages.note: Orange and dark brown lines loop across the panels with light green marks; an angular black shape on the right panel.

stages.label: First fills
stages.note: Orange, olive and grey begin to fill the shapes on the left and middle panels.

stages.label: Built up
stages.note: Yellow, white and green spread through the shapes; the middle panel becomes dense.

untitled-kraft-triptych-orange-2025.text: Three kraft-paper panels painted in one afternoon. Looping orange and dark brown lines were laid across all three panels first, then filled within an hour with olive, grey, yellow and white.
untitled-kraft-triptych-orange-2025.title: Untitled (Orange triptych)

stages.label: Outlines
stages.note: Thin orange and grey outlines of rounded shapes, pale green fills, and rubbed red and teal patches.

stages.label: Ochre and blue
stages.note: Yellow ochre fills the lower forms, blue appears at the right and bottom, and black accents at the top.

untitled-ochre-and-teal-2025.text: A tall sheet that started as thin orange outlines, pale green fills and rubbed patches of red and teal. Over the next two and a half weeks the lower forms were filled with yellow ochre and blue was added at the edges.
untitled-ochre-and-teal-2025.title: Untitled (Ochre and teal)

stages.label: Cluster on olive and magenta
stages.note: A dense cluster of grey, violet, green and black shapes around a pale blue centre, under an olive arc, with a magenta block at the lower right and grey-blue streaks at the lower left.

stages.label: Pink and brown forms
stages.note: Six days later pale pink, brown and blue forms fill the dark area at the left, a red and white shape appears below the centre, and pale pink shapes and white outlines are drawn over the bands along the bottom.

untitled-olive-blue-and-magenta-2026.text: An unstretched canvas from late October 2026: a dense cluster of grey, violet, green and black shapes around a pale blue centre, under an olive arc, with a magenta block at the lower right. In the last days of the month pale pink, brown and blue forms were added at the left and along the bottom.
untitled-olive-blue-and-magenta-2026.title: Untitled (Olive, blue and magenta)

stages.label: Lines on kraft
stages.note: Black, light blue, green and white lines loop across the sheet.

stages.label: Blocks of colour
stages.note: Orange, pink, blue, green and red fill the spaces between the lines, mostly in the upper half.

untitled-pastel-blocks-2025.text: A kraft-paper sheet that started in September as loose black, light blue, green and white lines. In November, blocks of orange, pink, blue, green and red were filled in between them. (The first photo is turned to match the second.)
untitled-pastel-blocks-2025.title: Untitled (Pastel blocks)

stages.label: First drawing
stages.note: Pencil hatching and lines across the canvas, with green and teal shapes and smudged grey in the middle; the plastic wrapper is still half on.

stages.label: Projection
stages.note: The next evening a projected image of pale shapes on blue falls across the canvas on its easel and the wall behind it.

stages.label: Finished
stages.note: Twelve days later the whole canvas is painted: pink and red lines and ochre and brown shapes at the top, blue and teal through the middle, and heavy black lines and grey washes across the lower half.

untitled-pink-lines-and-black-2026.text: A stretched canvas worked over two weeks in October 2026. It began as pencil hatching with green and teal shapes and smudged grey in the middle; the next evening an image was projected over it, and by 30 October the whole canvas was painted, with pink and red lines across the top and heavy black lines below.
untitled-pink-lines-and-black-2026.title: Untitled (Pink lines and black)

stages.label: A cluster
stages.note: Red, green and peach shapes with teal at the centre of the sheet, red lines trailing down.

stages.label: Three hours later
stages.note: Pale green washes spread above and below, with new black marks and a dark red shape.

untitled-red-and-green-2025.text: Made in one afternoon. A small cluster of red, green and peach shapes in the middle of a white sheet was opened up three hours later with pale green washes above and below.
untitled-red-and-green-2025.title: Untitled (Red and green)

stages.label: Grey bands
stages.note: Bands of grey and black rubbed and brushed across the sheet on the floor.

stages.label: Closer
stages.note: The texture of the grey bands, with small drawn marks between them.

stages.label: Red figures
stages.note: Dark red figure-like forms, a blue circle and an orange-brown wash are painted over the grey.

stages.label: On the wall
stages.note: Hung on the wall, with yellow marks at the left and more blue at the right.

stages.label: White lines
stages.note: White outlines are drawn over the grey and brown at both sides and along the bottom, around the red figures.

untitled-red-figures-on-grey-2025.text:
A collaboration with [@raven_vafadar](https://www.instagram.com/raven_vafadar/). It has been a blast.

A large unstretched sheet that began on the studio floor as bands of grey and black. The next day red, blue and orange-brown forms were painted over the bands; by the end of June it hung on the wall as a broad horizontal painting, and in August white lines were drawn over the grey and brown around the figures. (The early photos are turned to match the final orientation.)
untitled-red-figures-on-grey-2025.title: Equanimity

stages.label: Red lines
stages.note: Thin red lines drawn across the canvas with a long straight edge, left to drip; the straight edge still lies across it.

stages.label: Denser
stages.note: An hour and a half later the lattice is denser and spreads further to the left and top, with drips running down to a red band along the bottom.

stages.label: Thick red
stages.note: The next day thick, dark red shapes are painted into the upper part of the lattice.

stages.label: Black, olive and yellow
stages.note: A day later black loops and olive, green, grey and violet forms fill the right half, with yellow marks at the top and along the lower right.

stages.label: With a sculpture in AR
stages.note: That evening, seen through a phone with a white sculpture placed in front of it in augmented reality.

stages.label: Violet at the edge
stages.note: Three weeks later a dark violet block runs down the right edge, with grey and a brown cross added at the left.

stages.label: White and blue
stages.note: Three days later white and pale shapes are added at the left, with touches of blue through the black forms in the middle.

untitled-red-lattice-2026.text: An unstretched canvas begun on 3 October 2026 as a lattice of thin red lines, drawn with a straight edge and left to drip. The next day thick red shapes were painted into the upper part; on 5 October black, olive, green and yellow forms filled the right half, and later in the month violet, grey and white were added at the edges.
untitled-red-lattice-2026.title: Untitled (Red lattice)

stages.label: The V
stages.note: Red, ochre and pink lines form a V shape over long black diagonals.

stages.label: Teal and magenta
stages.note: Teal strokes enter from the left, and red, magenta and purple lines are added over the V.

untitled-red-v-2025.text: Red, ochre and pink lines drawn over long black diagonals on white paper. Five days later the composition was crowded with teal on the left and new red, magenta and purple lines.
untitled-red-v-2025.title: Untitled (Red V)

stages.label: Reeds
stages.note: Long dark strokes fan out from the left, and green, reed-like brushmarks cross the middle and right sheets.

stages.label: The ground below
stages.note: Bands of pale green, blue, pink and ochre fill the lower half, with a dark grey block at the lower right.

stages.label: Five days later
stages.note: The three sheets seen together again, hung on a yellow wall.

untitled-reeds-2025.text: Painted across three sheets of paper hung side by side. Long dark strokes and green, reed-like brushmarks went down first, reaching across all three sheets; less than an hour later the lower half was filled with bands of pastel colour.
untitled-reeds-2025.title: Untitled (Reeds)

stages.label: The column
stages.note: Thick white, blue and black paint in a vertical column of looping forms on a grey ground.

stages.label: Ochre and red-brown
stages.note: Ochre, red-brown and light blue are added, and a small pale figure appears near the top.

stages.label: Orange band
stages.note: An orange band crosses the top under grey-white strokes, and the column is built up in thicker paint.

untitled-tall-column-2025.text: A narrow vertical painting on a grey ground, built up over two months. A column of looping white, blue and black forms came first; ochre, red-brown and light blue followed a week later, and by September an orange band crossed the top.
untitled-tall-column-2025.title: Untitled (Tall column)

stages.label: Three panels
stages.note: Green, yellow and orange on the top panel; blue-green outlined shapes on the middle panel; yellow and blue outlines on the floor.

stages.label: Red and orange
stages.note: The top panel turns red and orange, and the middle and lower panels fill with darker colour.

stages.label: White outlines
stages.note: White and black outlines with bright orange are painted over the top panel.

untitled-three-panels-2025.text: Three kraft-paper panels, two leaning against the wall and one on the floor, worked on together in one afternoon. The top panel changed most, from green and yellow to orange with white and black outlines.
untitled-three-panels-2025.title: Untitled (Three panels)

stages.label: Hung in a dim room
stages.note: Black-outlined circles and boxes in a vertical composition, with ochre and orange stains on the ground.

stages.label: Two days later
stages.note: Seen closer, with blue around the circle and the central boxes.

untitled-two-circles-2025.text: A tall painting with two circles, one blue and one drawn in black rings, joined by a column of boxes and lines over an ochre and orange-stained ground. (The first photo is turned to match the second.)
untitled-two-circles-2025.title: Untitled (Two circles)

stages.label: Violet shapes
stages.note: Looping violet and lilac brushwork around a pale pink centre, with grey-black blocks along the top.

stages.label: Drawn over
stages.note: Dark brown, black and deep red lines are added over the violet forms, and more red appears in the centre.

untitled-violet-2025.text: The painting began with loose violet and lilac shapes on a cream ground. Three weeks later it was drawn over in dark brown, black and deep red, giving the soft forms hard edges.
untitled-violet-2025.title: Untitled (Violet)

stages.label: Arches
stages.note: White strokes and arches, red-brown and grey-blue vertical strokes, and a teal shape in the centre.

stages.label: Drips
stages.note: More white drips and vertical strokes run down the sheet.

untitled-white-arches-2025.text: White arches and drips on kraft paper, with vertical strokes of red-brown and grey-blue and a teal bird-like shape. In under an hour the white strokes were extended down the sheet.
untitled-white-arches-2025.title: Untitled (White arches)

stages.label: Grey loops on pink
stages.note: Pale pink and yellow washes with a brown-black block at the top left, and a cluster of grey loops and white shapes with orange-yellow patches; a white patch at the right. (Photographed on the floor and turned to match the later photos.)

stages.label: Yellow, green and blue
stages.note: Two days later, on the wall: bright yellow and white fill the middle of the cluster, a green mass grows at the right, blue shapes appear at the lower right, and brown forms at the left.

stages.label: Defined
stages.note: Two weeks later the forms are more defined: orange, red-brown and dark marks through the yellow, a darker brown figure at the left, and black marks along the lower left.

stages.label: Red figures
stages.note: Red shapes and pale lilac and white figures are added at the upper left, with more red through the top of the cluster.

untitled-yellow-and-green-on-pink-2026.text: An unstretched canvas washed in pale pink and yellow, with a brown-black block at the top left, worked on through October 2026. It began on the studio floor as a cluster of grey loops and white shapes; two days later it hung on the wall with the cluster filled in yellow, green and blue, and by the end of the month red and lilac figures had been added at the upper left.
untitled-yellow-and-green-on-pink-2026.title: Untitled (Yellow and green on pink)

stages.label: Pinned to the doors
stages.note: Black lines and blue, grey and green forms across the canvas, over a yellow ground in the lower part and a pale yellow column at the right.

stages.label: Pink and white
stages.note: Eight days later pink, lilac and orange are added at the left and top, thick white paint curls through the middle, and pale blue appears at the top right.

stages.label: Violet and magenta
stages.note: That afternoon a spiky dark violet shape is added at the top right, magenta and dark red shapes along the bottom, and more blue and pink at the left.

stages.label: On the wall
stages.note: Two days later, hung on the wall, with deeper violet across the top and more dark line work through the middle.

untitled-yellow-ground-2026.text: An unstretched canvas worked over ten days in November 2026. It began with black lines and blue, grey and green forms over a yellow ground; on 10 November pink, violet and thick white paint were worked through it, then dark violet and magenta, and by 12 November it hung finished on the wall.
untitled-yellow-ground-2026.title: Untitled (Yellow ground)

stages.label: The structure
stages.note: Black dotted lines with dark red, ochre and blue on a long white sheet, with yellow washes in the middle.

stages.label: Yellow washes
stages.note: More yellow wash spreads across the sheet.

stages.label: Brown and green ground
stages.note: A block of brown appears at the top left, and pale green-yellow washes cover the left half.

untitled-yellow-hook-2025.text: A tall figure-like structure drawn in black dotted lines with dark red, ochre and blue, topped by a yellow hook. Over the following month, yellow and pale green washes and a block of brown were laid into the ground around it.
untitled-yellow-hook-2025.title: Untitled (Yellow hook)
